Bike the Heights! Slow Roll

Arlington Heights, IL · Social

Bike the Heights! Slow Roll is a social group ride in Arlington Heights, IL. It rolls fourth Friday of the month at 6:15 pm from Harmony Park.

Next ride Fri, Oct 23, 6:15 PM CDT

How we know

Chicago Family Biking's events page lists Bike the Heights! Slow Roll on Fri Aug 28, Sep 25 and Oct 23, 2026, meet 6:00 PM, roll 6:15 PM at Harmony Park, 7 S Vail Ave, Arlington Heights (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Weather permitting; updates go on the ride's Facebook event. It's listed on Chicago Family Biking's family-ride calendar, whose guidelines ask for helmets and a parent or guardian with each child.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike the Heights! Slow Roll group ride

Arlington Heights' monthly slow roll from Harmony Park, listed on Chicago Family Biking's family-ride calendar. The October ride is a Halloween ride.
